source: Copied from archipelago-workers/stats/test/unit/hot-scenes-handler.spec.ts (see reference/). The gatekeeper /hot-scenes port must reproduce these results from its presence map.
rules: input = per-parcel peer counts of the MAIN realm only (world peers are ignored)
occupied tiles are joined with Catalyst scene entities (fetchEntitiesByPointers), cached; a tile whose entity has no metadata or no metadata.scene is skipped
one HotSceneInfo per scene: usersTotalCount = sum of peers over the scene's parcels; parcels = every parcel of the scene (not only occupied ones) as [x,y]; baseCoords from metadata.scene.base
thumbnail = calculateThumbnail(entity) exactly as reference/content.ts (relative navmapThumbnail -> `${contentUrl}/contents/${hash}` via the entity's content list; unresolvable -> undefined)
creator = metadata.contact.name, projectId = metadata.source.projectId, description = metadata.display.description, name = metadata.display.title
result sorted by usersTotalCount desc, truncated to 100, served as a BARE ARRAY (no envelope)
503 {"ok":false,"error":"warming"} until the presence map has been primed

cases.name: should not crash when a scene has no metadata
should not crash when scene metadata has no scene field
